关键词: President’s Working Group on Financial Markets
主要内容: On December 22, 2020, the President’s Working Group on Financial Markets (PWG) released a report examining the stress in short-term funding markets during March 2020, which was driven by economic concerns related to the COVID-19 pandemic and a flight to liquidity and quality among investors. The report highlights the need for reforms to improve the resilience of money market funds and broader short-term funding markets. Deputy Secretary Justin Muzinich emphasized that while reforms after the global financial crisis increased market stability, the events of March 2020 showed that more work is needed to reduce the risk of structural vulnerabilities in prime and tax-exempt money market funds. The PWG report does not endorse any specific reform but instead promotes the study and discussion of potential policy measures. The PWG includes the Secretary of the Treasury, the Chair of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission, and the Chairman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.
